email.subject: AI for Law Office of Bilello, Zapantis, Garner & Puglisi, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Andrew,

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms serving the Westbury area and beyond that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in the New York region to meet with firms like yours. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar practices compete with larger competitors.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
